entities.summary: Sean Daniel Maitland is a retired New Zealand-born Scottish rugby union player. He last played for Saracens in the Premiership Rugby. He previously played for London Irish and before that for Glasgow Warriors in the PRO12, Crusaders in Super Rugby and Canterbury in the Mitre 10 Cup. His regular playing positions were Wing and Full back.
